critical_code_review_comments: routes/tenant_meta.py L131-147 (add_country): the POST builds doc then does insert_one(doc.copy()) and then doc.pop('_id', None) on the original — but Motor mutates the .copy() to add _id, not the original. The final return doc has no _id leak: OK. However the .copy() pattern is misleading; prefer `insert_one(doc)` then `doc.pop('_id', None)` so the line is intentional and obviously correct.

routes/tenant_meta.py L70-91 (_resolve_tenant_id): mirrors the same heuristic as cashier/HR (parent_client_id → client_id → canonical-by-company → self). The company-fallback under `account_status: {'$ne':'deleted'}` could match a foreign tenant if two distinct tenants share a normalised company string. Same concern flagged in iter33; consider centralising the resolver into a shared helper so a single bugfix covers cashier, HR, and tenant_meta.

routes/tenant_meta.py L101-113 (_build_meta): when the admin deletes the currently-selected country, the code falls back to BF — good. But the tenant_country doc still references the deleted code; consider auto-rewriting it back to BF in the DELETE handler to avoid silent drift.

tenant_meta seed (_ensure_seeded): seeding is gated on count==0, so adding new defaults later (e.g. Mauritania/MR) will not be picked up by existing tenants. Add a small idempotent upsert-loop keyed on `code` to backfill new default codes on each startup.
Iter38b new endpoints all read `_id`-stripped projections (good). Confirmed no ObjectId leaks in PDF/JSON payslip responses.

rca of the issue: No product bugs found. The frontend UI smoke test in this iteration was blocked by a test-harness mistake: my script re-POSTed /api/auth/login to grab dev_otp AFTER the page had already moved to the OTP-entry step. That second login rotated the server-side session_token, so the OTP my page knew about (printed on screen as 117138) was no longer the active one. Submitting it returned 400. The fix is purely test-side: read OTP from the page's displayed text (since SMTP is not configured, the page literally shows it) instead of refetching via /api/auth/login. Documented in test_credentials for the next agent.
